newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Eletrobras still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Eletrobras still a buy.

text.p: ING Barings said it is maintaining its buy rating on Brazilian federal power holding Eletrobras, which is due to be privatized next year.
-- ING analyst Charles Barnett said in a report Eletrobras' preferred B share has an upside potential of 21 percent while the firm's common stock has an upside potential of 28 percent.
-- "Eletrobras is the top performing Latin power stock in the month of June - up 21-percent in U.S. dollar terms - and has hit new highs," Barnett wrote.
-- He said the stock is still trading at a seven-percent trading discount to the average of Latin generating firms and a 27-percent to the Latin generator average without Eletrobras.
-- He placed the market value of Eletrobras' generation and transmission assets at just $718 per Kw, a 47-percent discount to the Latin American generator average excluding Eletrobras of $1,326.
-- He set a 12-month price target of 815 per 1,000 shares, or $36 per ADR.
-- Barnett said he is confident that the government will privatize the major Eletrobras assets before the end of 1998.

-- Moreover, "we believe our valuation is conservative given that further tariff increases, cost cutting and increased revenue from transmission tolls could deliver upside surprises in 1998," he wrote.
-- Eletrobras preferred B was off 1.82 percent at 648 reais while its common was down 1.44 percent at 615 reais at 1614 local/1514 edt in Sao Paulo.
